Class NativeSdCard

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.internal.NativeSdCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
SdCard
public final class NativeSdCard extends Object implements SdCard
The card in a shield's SD socket: each method but begin() is an SD intrinsic the compiler lowers to the SdFat library, so it has no Java body and cannot run, or be mocked, on a desktop JVM. Mock SdCard instead. The board has one SD bus, so every instance drives the same card; an instance only remembers the chip-select pin of the socket it was made for.

      public int size(String path)
      Description copied from interface: SdCard
      Returns the size of path in bytes, or -1 when it does not exist or cannot be opened. A file over Integer.MAX_VALUE bytes reports Integer.MAX_VALUE. Use it to tell whether a log has grown too large or a file is empty; InputStream.available() only says whether bytes remain.

    • freeKiB

      public int freeKiB()
      Description copied from interface: SdCard
      The card volume's free space in KiB, or -1 before a successful SdCard.begin(). A FAT32 card's own free-space count (its FSInfo sector, kept by the computer that last wrote the card) answers at once, though it may lag a few clusters behind writes the board made since. Without one, the whole allocation table is counted, which can take a minute on a large card; the count pauses between slices so other threads keep running, but the calling thread waits for all of it, so call this from a background thread and keep the result.
      Specified by:
      freeKiB in interface SdCard
